all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header: def mixedProgressionMass (d : MediumAtom) (q r : ℕ) : ℂ
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_definition:
def mixedProgressionMass (d : MediumAtom) (q r : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n *
    ((∑ m ∈ d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
      if m.Coprime r ∧ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
        then d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m else 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)

actual_row_product_eq_pair
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem actual_row_product_eq_pair (d : MediumAtom) (m : ℕ) :
    d.transposedAtom.complexProgressionRow m *
        star (d.transposedAtom.complexPrincipalRow m) =
      ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
        mixedPairCoefficient d q r *
          ∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n *
            (if m.Coprime r ∧ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
              then (1 : ℂ) else 0)

theorem actualMixedTerm_eq_row_sum (d : MediumAtom) :
    actualMixedTerm d =
      ∑ m ∈ d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
        (d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m : ℂ) *
          (d.transposedAtom.complexProgressionRow m *
            star (d.transposedAtom.complexPrincipalRow m))

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: actualV_sub_primitive_norm_le
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem actualV_sub_primitive_norm_le (d : MediumAtom) :
    ‖(d.transposedAtom.complexDispersionV d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier
      d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) - primitiveZeroMain d‖ ≤
        ‖actualMixedTerm d - primitiveZeroMain d‖

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: primitiveZeroMain_eq_mixed_main
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem primitiveZeroMain_eq_mixed_main
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    primitiveZeroMain d =
      ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
        mixedPairCoefficient d q r *
          (coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha q *
            (((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass / q) *
              ∑ e ∈ r.divisors.filter (fun e ↦ e.Coprime q),
                (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℝ) / e : ℝ) : ℂ))

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: actualMixedTerm_sub_primitive_eq
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem actualMixedTerm_sub_primitive_eq
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    actualMixedTerm d - primitiveZeroMain d =
      ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
        mixedPairCoefficient d q r *
          (mixedProgressionMass d q r - coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha q *
            (((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass / q) *
              ∑ e ∈ r.divisors.filter (fun e ↦ e.Coprime q),
                (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℝ) / e : ℝ) : ℂ))

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: mixedProgressionMass_sub_main_uniform_bound
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem mixedProgressionMass_sub_main_uniform_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : MediumAtom, 1 ≤ d.V → ∀ q r : ℕ,
      0 < q → r ≠ 0 → Int.gcd d.residue q = 1 →
      ‖mixedProgressionMass d q r - coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha q *
        (((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass / q) *
          ∑ e ∈ r.divisors.filter (fun e ↦ e.Coprime q),
            (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℝ) / e : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
        C * coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier (fun n ↦ ‖d.alpha n‖) q *
          (r.divisors.card : ℝ)

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: actualV_sub_primitive_finite_bound
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem actualV_sub_primitive_finite_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d →
      ‖(d.transposedAtom.complexDispersionV d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) - primitiveZeroMain d‖ ≤
        C * ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
          ‖mixedPairCoefficient d q r‖ *
            coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier (fun n ↦ ‖d.alpha n‖) q *
              (r.divisors.card : ℝ)

The literal transposed progression row and principal row are grouped exactly. The finite double complex mixed sum equals the actual smoothed row product; the literal real dispersion V is its real part.

The separate Hermitian proof makes the actual primitive zero main term P0 real. Consequently taking real parts contracts norm(actualMixedTerm-P0); no false equality of the complex mixed term with literal real V is used.
The exact restricted Moebius density phi(q*r)/(phi(q)*q*r) identifies the mixed arithmetic main term with the same P0 used by the actual U and raw zero mode. Every local cutoff mass is unchanged.

For alpha integers not coprime to q the reduced-residue product progression is exactly empty. For coprime alpha integers the actual local mixed smooth progression error is bounded by C*tau(r). Summing the actual alpha weights produces the displayed finite envelope as a conclusion.

The positive C precedes all arithmetic parameters and medium atoms, with no extra coefficient or error budget premise. This leaf has not paid the U^2*cap logarithmic envelope or any final distribution endpoint.
